feed.title: News and communications from Competition and Markets Authority (CMA)

entry.title: CMA correspondence in relation to private provision in the dentistry market
entry.summary: Letters between the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) and minsters in the UK government, the Welsh and Scottish governments and the Northern Ireland Executive, and the CMA's response to the General Dental Council&#…

entry.title: CMA study reveals catalogue of concerns in private dentistry market
entry.summary: The CMA has today published interim findings in its market study into the UK’s £8 billion private dentistry market.

entry.title: Major fragrance suppliers fined £85 million by the CMA for illegal collusion
entry.summary: 3 fragrance suppliers broke competition law by coordinating their approach to pricing strategies and commercial negotiations.

entry.title: CMA considers remedies to resolve coatings merger concerns
entry.summary: The CMA believes remedies offered could resolve its concerns over AkzoNobel’s acquisition of Axalta Coatings.

entry.title: McCormick offers remedies to resolve competition concerns in Unilever Foods deal
entry.summary: Proposals offered by McCormick could address concerns over its acquisition of Unilever’s food business in the UK.

entry.title: CMA response to Consumer Services Code Review consultations
entry.summary: The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) has responded to Citizens Advice and Consumer Scotland consultations on their Consumer Service Codes Reviews.

entry.title: CMA provisionally finds that viagogo may have broken the law on hidden fees
entry.summary: Investigation considers how mandatory costs were presented to UK fans on 3 viagogo websites.

entry.title: Travel and leisure businesses investigated over pricing practices
entry.summary: CMA launches 3 new investigations over concerns that customers were not shown the total price upfront when purchasing holidays or gym memberships.

entry.title: Power, agency and good growth
entry.summary: A speech by Sarah Cardell, the CMA’s Chief Executive, delivered at the Chatham House Competition Policy Conference 2026.

entry.title: CMA response to consultation on equal pay and pay discrimination
entry.summary: The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) response to the Office for Equality and Opportunity's consultation on reform of the current equal pay framework.

entry.title: CMA publishes decision in strategic review of market remedies
entry.summary: Decision focuses on whether remedies remain appropriate and continue to deliver benefits.

entry.title: Online retailers: including mandatory delivery fees in the total price
entry.summary: Open letter to remind online retailers in the UK that mandatory delivery fees must be included in the total price and shown to consumers up front.

entry.title: CMA opens investigation into Meta’s commercial terms
entry.summary: Investigation will examine concerns that Meta’s terms and conditions unfairly harm news publishers and other content businesses.

entry.title: Aldi and Lidl will be subject to same rules as major supermarkets
entry.summary: CMA confirms Aldi and Lidl will be covered by the same land agreement rules as the UK’s other large supermarkets to ensure customers get the best choice of where to shop.

entry.title: CMA outlines proposals to unlock contactless technology on Apple iPhone
entry.summary: Opening up iPhone contactless technology could boost innovation, lower costs and help UK fintechs grow.

entry.title: CMA takes first steps to ensure choice in business software
entry.summary: CMA proposes to designate Microsoft with strategic market status in its business software ecosystem.

entry.title: CMA fines firms £6 million for misleading sales tactics
entry.summary: Customers will receive around £440,000 in refunds.

entry.title: Remedies offered to resolve concerns in non-domestic meter reading merger
entry.summary: Remedies submitted by Macquarie to address concerns over its acquisition of EAG may be accepted

entry.title: CMA considers proposals to address concerns over cash machine deal
entry.summary: Remedies offered by Brink’s to address competition concerns over its acquisition of NCR may be accepted.

entry.title: CMA proposes to accept remedies package in Co-op Group deal to address competition concerns
entry.summary: Undertakings offered by Co-op Group could address competition concerns relating to its acquisition of Southern Co-op.
